title: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
summary: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.

title: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto
summary: Leap, built by the team behind Dialect, launched a beta iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto on Solana, pitching itself to traders looking beyond meme coins.

title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
summary: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.

title: Solana Microscope Offers Open-Source Monitoring for Complex On-Chain Operations
summary: The Solana Foundation has described Microscope, an open-source monitoring approach for teams managing on-chain programmes and infrastructure.
